# SEO Specialist Portfolio

> Portfolio of an SEO specialist: technical SEO, local SEO, Google Business Profile optimisation and content strategy. Open to freelance projects and full-time roles.

## Pages

- [Home](/): about, résumé, case studies, insights and contact details
- [Insights](/insights): articles on search, rankings and SEO practice
- [Case studies](/#work): each project has its own page at /work/<name>, with the client's industry, the strategy and the measured results

## Contact

The "Get in Touch" section at the bottom of the home page (/#contact) lists phone, email and LinkedIn.
